title: Hosting & Infrastructure

seo.title: Hosting & Infrastructure | Julie Zimmerman
seo.description: Hosting and infrastructure engineering for fleet standards, lifecycle management, migration, recovery, and performance.

hero.headline: Operating web infrastructure with standards, visibility, and an exit plan.
intro: I manage hosting as an operational system: environments, DNS, SSL, backups, deployment, updates, capacity, lifecycle, and incident response across more than 250 active web properties.
That experience led me to formalize managed-hosting standards around supportability and planned obsolescence rather than allowing every environment to become a permanent exception.

philosophy.title: Engineering Philosophy
philosophy.anchor: Infrastructure is reliable when routine work is predictable and exceptional work is recoverable.
philosophy.intro: Every environment needs a known owner, purpose, and lifecycle.
principles: Backups matter only when restoration is understood and tested.
Deployment and update practices should reduce drift.
Unsupported infrastructure is a business risk, not merely a technical inconvenience.
philosophy.closing: Unsupported infrastructure is a business risk, not merely a technical inconvenience.

problems.title: Problems I Solve
problems.intro: The most valuable work usually begins where a system has accumulated complexity, operational risk, or assumptions no one has revisited.

approach.title: How I Work
paragraphs: I standardize the repeatable parts while documenting legitimate exceptions. That creates enough consistency to detect drift without pretending every workload is identical.
Infrastructure decisions include the eventual migration or retirement path, because systems that cannot change safely become liabilities.

experience.summary: Lead developer and systems architect for a large, long-lived portfolio of production websites and integrations.
evidence: Technical standards, migration planning, launch QA, and incident response

experience.summary: Technical lead in enterprise higher-education software, working across large Oracle systems, performance testing, defect analysis, and release delivery.
evidence: Synthetic data generation exceeding one million records

related_writing.title: Related Writing
related_writing.intro: Case studies and essays that show the underlying engineering decisions.

business_value.title: Why lifecycle management matters
paragraphs: Infrastructure becomes expensive when every environment is treated as permanent and unique.
Clear standards and planned obsolescence reduce technical debt, shorten incident response, and make future migrations possible before they become emergencies.

contact.title: Let's Talk
paragraphs: For technical leadership, architecture, modernization, or complex systems work, contact me directly.

closing_statement: Reliable infrastructure includes a plan for change, not just a plan for today.
